title: Recovery 1.5 - diode mode on the J29 holes
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: Diode mode: red lead on hole 1 (then hole 2), black lead on hole 3 (GND); then swapped. About 0.4-0.7 V in one direction is a chip pin's protection diode: a live line.

callouts.label: J29 hole 1 (dot end)
callouts.note: The bottom hole; the pin-1 dot is printed left of it. TP29's net (beeper, J-112). Red lead here first.

callouts.label: J29 hole 2
callouts.note: The middle hole. TP28's net (beeper, J-112). Red lead here second.

callouts.label: J29 hole 3, GND
callouts.note: The top hole, '3' printed above it. GND (J-112). Black lead here for both readings, then swapped.

terminals.label: Meter red lead (diode): hole 1, then hole 2
